sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, host Alsager Town on Saturday 3 October at 15:00. Despite a recent loss, Sandbach remain in strong form with seven wins from their last ten matches. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just four points and have won only once all season, making this a fixture Sandbach will be heavy favourites to win.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back from recent mixed form and close the one-point gap to leaders Sandbach. AFC Bridgnorth face Eccleshall at home—both teams are in contention for promotion, though Bridgnorth have stumbled with two recent losses while Eccleshall showed resilience with a win in their last outing. Wolverhampton Casuals are away at Wednesfield Community in a midweek fixture on Wednesday; Casuals come in on the back of three consecutive wins and will be confident against a Wednesfield side struggling with inconsistency. Bilston Town host Foley Meir on Saturday, with Bilston's strong recent form (three wins in their last four) positioning them well in the promotion hunt. Market Drayton Town entertain New Mills in a clash between mid-table sides both seeking consistency. Shawbury United, winless in five games, host Barnton, who by contrast are in decent shape with back-to-back wins. Crewe face Allscott Heath at home, with both teams fighting in the lower reaches of the division. Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a bottom-half encounter, while Widnes Town—pointless in their last five—visit Brereton Social. Brereton Social then host Wednesfield Community again on Wednesday evening, the second meeting between these sides in quick succession.
